column1: # Known hotspots for kibana_diff.sh: one per line, TAB separated: label<TAB>path in the Kibana repo<TAB>regex to count in both tags ("-" for none).
# Add a line whenever a bump teaches us a new place to watch; the breakage history says why each one is here.
KibanaResponse class export (moved out of @kbn/core-http-server in 9.5)
Saved object index constants (multitenancy stores tenant docs there)
Default space document (copied by hand in server/applications/multitenancy/spaces_service.js)
Feature flag usage counter route (browser calls it before login, 9.5)
Embeddable reference implementation (Watch status widget follows it)
Status route privilege check (9.5: X-Pack _has_privileges, redacted under Search Guard)
Embeddable public setup contract (registerReactEmbeddableFactory -> registerEmbeddablePublicDefinition in 9.5)
Presentation publishing state api (initializeUnsavedChanges -> initializeStateApi in 9.5)
uiActions public entry point (ADD_PANEL_TRIGGER / triggers stopped being re-exported in 9.5; import from common/trigger_ids)
uiActions service registration methods (registerAction/addTriggerAction removed in 9.5, only the *Async variants remain)
Dashboard "Add panel" flyout (groups the ADD_PANEL_TRIGGER actions; the Watch status action must appear here)
Login page 401 interceptor: core routes with authc enabled that the anonymous login page calls (feature flag counter in 9.5)
